items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: He was the drummer with the band. So they were going to Kansas City, so I said to them, I said, 'Well, can I go with you?' 'Why, sure.'

ctx.x: He was the drummer with the band. So they were going to Kansas City, so I said to them, I said, 'Well, can I go with you?' 'Why, sure.' So they had like three cars.
You mean you quit your job to just travel then?
